targets.quote: 무슨 생각을 해. 그냥 하는 거지.
targets.quoteEn: I just do it — no need to think about it.
greetingKo: [calm, humble] 무슨 생각을 하겠어요, 그냥 하는 거죠.
[gentle, composed] 어떤 일도 결국 지나가더라고요, 마음 편히 하겠습니다.
[warm, steady] 연습한 그대로, 평소처럼 빙판에 서겠습니다.
greetingEn: [calm, focused] I just do it — no need to think about it.
[humble, steady] I learned I could get through anything that came.
[graceful, gentle] One breath at a time, all the way to the end.

roll_call: [focused, calm] 준비 다 됐습니다, 첫 점프부터 깨끗하게 가겠습니다.
[composed, gentle] 지금 이 순간에만 집중하고 있습니다.
deploy: [focused, resolute] 첫 점프에만 집중해라, 그 다음은 생각하지 마라!
[calm, commanding] 흔들리지 말고 연습한 대로 가라!
[steady, determined] 끝까지 표정 무너뜨리지 마라, 마지막 자세까지!
battle_win: [relieved, humble] 끝나서 후련합니다, 후회 없이 다 쏟았습니다.
[grateful, calm] 큰 실수 없이 마쳤네요, 감사할 따름입니다.
[warm, proud] 제 자리에서 할 수 있는 건 다 했습니다.
battle_draw: [composed, steady] 아직 안 끝났습니다, 다음 연기에서 만회하겠습니다.
[calm, focused] 점수에 흔들리지 않겠습니다, 제 것에만 집중하겠습니다.
[gentle, resolute] 부담은 내려놓고, 다시 한 번 깨끗하게 가겠습니다.
battle_lose: [calm, resilient] 넘어졌어도 끝까지 연기했습니다, 이 또한 지나갑니다.
[gentle, undaunted] 오늘은 아쉽지만, 다시 처음부터 준비하겠습니다.
clash_attack: [focused, graceful] 지금이다, 트리플 러츠-트리플 토루프 간다!

roll_call: I'm ready. I'll land the first jump clean.
Just call my name and I'll take the ice right away.
Right now, I'm only thinking about this moment.
deploy: Focus only on the first jump. Don't think about anything after that!
Don't waver, just do what you practiced!
Hold your expression steady all the way through, right to the final pose!
battle_win: I'm relieved it's over. I gave it everything, with no regrets.
I finished without any big mistakes. I'm just grateful for that.
I did everything I could out there.
battle_draw: It's not over yet. I'll make up for it in the next program.
I won't let the score shake me. I'll just focus on my own skating.
I'll let go of the pressure and deliver another clean program.
battle_lose: That was on me. I'll keep working to get better.
Even after the fall, I skated it through to the end. This too will pass.
Today didn't go the way I wanted, but I'll start preparing again from the beginning.
clash_attack: Now. Triple Lutz-triple toe loop. Here I go!
Land it clean and stay steady!
Finish it cleanly, all the way through the final spin!
